content.user_title: Optimize In-App Paywalls and Upgrade Flows
content.value_statement: Many upgrade prompts appear too early, hide value, or create distrust. This skill helps design timely paywalls, clear upgrade copy, and measurable experiments.
actual_capabilities: Design feature gate, usage limit, trial expiration, soft prompt, and team upgrade paywalls.
Write paywall headlines, body copy, calls to action, and exit path text.
Recommend trigger timing, frequency caps, and dismissal behavior for upgrade prompts.
Adapt paywall guidance for web, iOS, and Android subscription flows.
Plan A/B tests for pricing display, trial structure, copy, layout, and personalization.
Define upgrade funnel metrics such as impressions, clicks, completion rate, revenue, and churn.
limitations: It needs product, pricing, usage, and audience context for precise recommendations.
It focuses on in-product upgrade moments, not public pricing pages or acquisition pages.
It does not implement checkout systems, payment processing, or subscription billing logic.
It does not replace legal, app store, tax, or subscription compliance review.

use_cases.title: Improve a Freemium Feature Gate
use_cases.description: Create a paywall that explains a locked feature, previews the benefit, and leaves a clear free path.

use_cases.title: Refine Trial Expiration Messaging
use_cases.description: Build reminders and expiration screens that summarize value received and reduce surprise at downgrade.

use_cases.title: Design Mobile Subscription Paywalls
use_cases.description: Plan mobile paywall structure, pricing display, restore purchase placement, and dismissal behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Paywall
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single upgrade screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an in-app paywall for a user who clicks a locked feature. The product is [product]. The paid feature is [feature]. Include headline, body copy, CTA, and exit path.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite an Existing Upgrade Modal
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with current copy and known friction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this upgrade modal for clarity and trust: [current copy]. The user just [context]. Keep the tone direct and avoid pressure tactics.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Trial Conversion Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple trial lifecycle screens.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a trial expiration flow for [product]. Include seven-day, three-day, one-day, expired, and post-upgrade states. Show trigger, copy, CTA, frequency, and metrics for each state.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Paywall Experiment Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for CRO testing and measurement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A/B testing plan for our in-app paywalls. Context: [audience], [pricing], [current conversion], [known objections]. Prioritize tests by expected impact, effort, and risk.

output_examples.input: A free user hits a three-project limit in a SaaS app.
output: Trigger: Show the prompt when the user tries to create the fourth project.
Headline: Keep building without project limits.
Exit path: Delete a project or return to dashboard.

output_examples.input: A trial user has three days left and used two premium features.
output: Message: Your trial ends in 3 days.
Value summary: You created projects and used premium reporting.

output_examples.input: A team admin tries to invite a second teammate on a solo plan.
output: Context: Show the upgrade prompt inside the invite flow.
Benefit: Explain shared projects, collaboration features, and admin controls.
Metric: Track invite attempts, upgrade clicks, and completed team upgrades.

best_practices: Show upgrade prompts after users experience value, not before they understand the product.
Make pricing, trial terms, cancellation, and downgrade options clear before payment.
Measure impressions, clicks, completions, churn, and annoyance signals for each paywall.
anti_patterns: Hiding close buttons, downgrade options, pricing, or subscription terms.
Using misleading urgency, guilt-based copy, or repeated prompts after dismissal.
Blocking critical workflows before users understand why the paid feature matters.

faq.question: What kinds of paywalls can this skill help create?
faq.answer: It can help with feature gates, usage limits, trial expiration screens, soft upgrade prompts, and team upgrade prompts.

faq.question: Can it write complete paywall copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft headlines, body copy, calls to action, value summaries, and dismissal text.

faq.question: Does it support mobile app paywalls?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for iOS and Android layout, subscription wording, tap targets, pricing display, and restore purchase placement.

faq.question: Does it handle payment implementation?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on paywall strategy, copy, UX, timing, and measurement, not billing code or payment processor setup.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product, pricing model, free limits, paid features, user journey, current conversion rate, and known objections.

faq.question: Can it help avoid dark patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes clear pricing, honest urgency, visible exit paths, and respectful dismissal behavior.
